## About
At Glen Burnie Transmissions, transmissions are the only thing we work on. We service cars, trucks, vans, buses and mobile homes across the Baltimore / Washington corridor, and each of our technicians specializes in a specific type of transmission.
A lot of what looks like a transmission problem isn't one. A faulty computer chip, an intermittent "prndl" switch or a leaking vacuum line can all feel the same from the driver's seat. That's why we diagnose first, and why customers like the one whose truck turned out to need tires, not a transmission, keep sending friends our way.
Customers name Ricardo, Gus and Paul Scherzo in their reviews, and we're rated 4.4 from 565 Google reviews.

## Services
- Automatic Transmission Service: Service, rebuild and replacement for car, truck and RV automatic transmissions, starting with a proper diagnosis.
- Manual Transmission Service: From grinding gears to not moving at all, we diagnose it and tell you exactly what it'll take to get you shifting again.
- Remanufactured Transmission: Built with the latest technology and rigorously tested before it goes in, so we can install the one your vehicle needs quickly.
- Transmission Rebuild: We replace the transmission parts that have failed.
- Clutch Rebuild: New clutch, pressure plates and throw out bearings, and we resurface and balance the flywheel to prevent early wear on the new parts.
- Rebuilt and Remanufactured Transfer Cases: Each remanufactured transfer case gets case-specific upgrades to correct manufacturing and engineering defects.
- Rebuilt and Remanufactured Differentials: Front and rear wheel drive differentials for cars and trucks, plus specialized differentials for racing or towing.
- Driveshaft Services: Drive shaft repair and balancing, done by master technicians.

## FAQ
Q: Do you do transmission flushes?
A: Generally, no. We remove the pan, replace the filter and gasket, and add back the amount of fluid that drained out. With today's better fluids, flushes aren't as necessary anymore.

Q: What kinds of vehicles do you work on?
A: Cars, trucks, mobile homes, buses, vans and four wheel drive vehicles.

Q: What if it turns out not to be the transmission?
A: We'll tell you. One reviewer on vacation said we figured out it wasn't a transmission problem and pointed them to other mechanics.

Q: Can you tow my car in?
A: Free towing is listed among our services. One customer had us tow her car from another shop at no charge.

Q: Do you offer financing?
A: Yes, through third parties. Our site lists Snap Finance, Synchrony Financing and Koalafi.
